description: MUTATES Memberful data: create one or more coupon codes for a discount. Provide the discount id (discountId) and the coupon code strings. Memberful GraphQL: createCoupons(discountId, coupons).

codes.description: Coupon code strings to create (at least one, required).

discountId.description: The discount id to attach the coupons to.
